title: BETA-Labeling for Multilingual Dataset Construction in Low-Resource IR
abstract: arXiv:2602.14488v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: IR in low-resource languages remains limited by the scarcity of high-quality, task-specific annotated datasets. Manual annotation is expensive and difficult to scale, while using large language models (LLMs) as automated annotators introduces concerns about label reliability, bias, and evaluation validity. This work presents a Bangla IR dataset constructed using a BETA-labeling framework involving multiple LLM annotators from diverse model families. The framework incorporates contextual alignment, consistency checks, and majority agreement, followed by human evaluation to verify label quality. Beyond dataset creation, we examine whether IR datasets from other low-resource languages can be effectively reused through one-hop machine translation. translated_title: BETA标注：面向低资源信息检索的多语言数据集构建方法
translated_abstract: 低资源语言的信息检索（IR）仍然受限于高质量、任务特定标注数据集的稀缺。人工标注成本高昂且难以规模化，而使用大语言模型（LLM）作为自动标注器则带来了标签可靠性、偏差和评估有效性方面的担忧。本研究使用BETA标注框架构建了一个孟加拉语IR数据集，该框架采用来自不同模型家族的多个LLM标注器。该框架结合了上下文对齐、一致性检查和多数同意机制，随后通过人工评估来验证标签质量。除了数据集构建之外，我们还研究了来自其他低资源语言的IR数据集是否可以通过一跳机器翻译实现有效复用。通过基于LLM的翻译在多个语言对上进行实验，我们检验了源数据集与翻译数据集之间的语义保留和任务有效性。我们的实验揭示了显著的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出BETA标注框架，利用多个不同模型家族的大语言模型标注器并结合一致性检查与人工评估构建了孟加拉语信息检索数据集，同时通过实验证明其他低资源语言的IR数据集可以借助一跳机器翻译得到有效复用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a BETA-labeling framework that constructs a Bangla IR dataset using multiple LLM annotators from diverse model families with consistency checks and human evaluation, and demonstrates that IR datasets from other low-resource languages can be effectively reused via one-hop machine translation.
